basis: The frozen metadata scan proves that required decision_at and feature_cutoff_at instants genuinely differ within most registered ticker/timing groups.

effect.evaluation_cohorts: Add normalized decision_at and feature_cutoff_at to the cohort key so only groups with identical information boundaries compete; this changes the registered evaluation cohorts and will frequently yield singleton cohorts.
effect.feature_aggregation: Never average features across different decision or cutoff instants.
effect.temporal_isolation: Retain feature_cutoff_at <= decision_at < entry_at < exit_at, feature-source <= cutoff, train/validation separation, purge, and embargo without relaxation.

proposed_change: Define an operational group by the registered five fields plus UTC-normalized decision_at and feature_cutoff_at; require raw timestamps to be aware ISO-8601 values and compare equivalent instants after UTC normalization.
warning: This materially changes training units and evaluation cohorts. The existing execution authorization does not cover it, and no amended training or evaluation may run without explicit review and authorization.
